[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Official seam only.** Start, message, and stop are thin adapters over `startContinuable` / `foll"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"owup` / `interrupt`; stop requests interruption and never kills processes.
- **`tool_filter` only re"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"stricts.** It removes tools from the child's view — never grants new ones; names are validated again"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"st `allowedChildTools`.
- **Approval-gated handoffs.** `room_transfer_task` routes through the offic"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ial approval seam and fails closed when no answerer grants it.
- **Model-visible ⟺ logged.** Every d"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"elivered room message is a durable `user/message` in the member's own log; the shared timeline mirro"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"rs as log-only `team-room/fact` events.
- **No scheduling, no cross-machine agents.** Children are p"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"rocess-local continuable sessions of the deployment."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Team rooms require the storage domain to be composed; without `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`, t"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"he `/room` command and `room_*` tools are disabled (the five `bg_*` tools still load).
- **Room-half"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" ownership is first-provider-wins.** This package's room half and the standalone `dsh-team-rooms` pa"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ckage register the same `roomHub` service key, the same eight `room_*` tools, the same `team-rooms` "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"settings slot and the same `team_rooms` storage domain. Cordis permits exactly one provider per serv"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ice key per isolate scope, so since **0.9.14** this package checks whether `roomHub` is already prov"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ided and stands its own room half down if so, logging `team rooms disabled: the roomHub service is a"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"lready provided`. When it stands down, `background_agent` and the five `bg_*` tools keep working and"},{"id":"p12s9","text":" rooms are served by the other package. Either package may be mounted first. On **≤ 0.9.13** there i"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"s no guard: mount only one of the two room halves.
- `provider` must name a continuable-capable prov"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ider (`prepareContinuable`); a missing provider makes `background_agent` fail until it appears.
- `m"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"axBackgroundAgents` is a shared budget across **every** continuable direct child of the session, inc"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"luding ones the built-in `subagent` tool started.
- One-shot children are never listed or messaged —"},{"id":"p12s14","text":" `bg_list` keeps continuable rows only.
